description: Replay an undo log for an ext2/ext3/ext4 file system.

option.name: -f
tip: Skip the superblock check that the undo log matches the file system.

option.name: -n
tip: Dry-run; do not write blocks back to the file system.

option.name: -o
tip: Specify the file system offset in bytes from the start of the device or file.

option.name: -v
tip: Report which block is currently being replayed.

option.name: -z
tip: Write the old contents of each block to an undo file.
